subject: Civil Engineering
title: Seismic Building Codes
description: A quick, practical guide to Seismic Building Codes.

hook.text: Earthquakes don't kill people. Badly built buildings do. Codes prevent that.

buildup.text: Building codes specify minimum seismic forces that every structure must be designed to resist.

discovery.text: The design force depends on seismic zone, soil type, building height, and structural system.

twist.text: Life safety is the minimum standard — the code allows damage but prevents collapse.

climax.text: After every major earthquake, codes are updated. Each disaster teaches new lessons.

punchline.text: The building code is written in lessons from collapsed structures.

quiz.question: What is the minimum performance goal of seismic building codes?
options: Zero damage to the building during any earthquake
Life safety — preventing collapse and protecting occupants even if the building is damaged
Full functionality immediately after the earthquake ends
